title: Who is Hacking the U.S. Economy?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访内容，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: This has been a year unlike any other.
sentences.zh: 这一年是不同寻常的一年。

sentences.en: And throughout it, we've tried to tell the story of just how profoundly people's lives have changed
sentences.zh: 在这一年里，我们试图讲述人们的生活发生了多么深刻变化的故事，

sentences.en: in places like Odessa, Texas, where we followed one school's attempt to reopen during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 比如在德克萨斯州的敖德萨，我们跟踪报道了一所学校在疫情期间尝试重新开放的过程。

sentences.en: Now, as the school year comes to a close, I'll be hosting a live virtual event, taking you behind the scenes of the making of that powerful series.
sentences.zh: 现在，随着学年即将结束，我将主持一场虚拟直播活动，带您深入了解那个系列报道背后的制作故事。

sentences.en: And thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Over the past few weeks, hackers demanding exorbitant ransoms have repeatedly held hostage vital segments of the American economy,
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，勒索赎金的黑客多次劫持了美国经济的重要部门，

sentences.en: threatening everything from the energy industry to the food supply.
sentences.zh: 威胁到了从能源行业到食品供应的方方面面。

sentences.en: Today, Sabrina Tavernisi spoke with our colleague, Nicole Perron, about why the attacks are becoming so common and who exactly is behind them.
sentences.zh: 今天，萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西与我们的同事妮可·佩隆谈论了为什么这些攻击变得如此普遍，以及幕后黑手究竟是谁。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, June 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月8日，星期二。

sentences.en: Nicole, I keep seeing these headlines about ransomware attacks, but I don't actually have a very good sense of what is happening.
sentences.zh: 妮可，我一直看到关于勒索软件攻击的头条新闻，但我其实不太清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Explain to me what's been going on in the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 请给我解释一下过去几周发生了什么。

sentences.en: So we've actually been seeing this never-ending onslaught of ransomware attacks.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们一直目睹着这种永无止境的勒索软件攻击浪潮。

sentences.en: But what happened over the last few weeks is that two key industries were hit with ransomware.
sentences.zh: 但过去几周发生的事情是，两个关键行业遭到了勒索软件的袭击。

sentences.en: Colonial pipeline.
sentences.zh: 科洛尼尔管道运输公司。

sentences.en: Colonial pipeline.
sentences.zh: 科洛尼尔管道运输公司。

sentences.en: Colonial pipeline.
sentences.zh: 科洛尼尔管道运输公司。

sentences.en: So there was a ransomware attack on Colonial pipeline.
sentences.zh: 所以，科洛尼尔管道运输公司遭到了勒索软件攻击。

sentences.en: It targeted the Colonial pipeline that runs from the Texas Gulf Coast through the southeast up to the northeast, 5,500 miles.
sentences.zh: 它针对的是那条从德克萨斯州墨西哥湾沿岸穿过东南部一直延伸到东北部、全长5500英里的科洛尼尔管道。

sentences.en: So workers showed up to work, turned on their computers, but instead of being able to access their email or other key operations, they were met with a ransomware note.
sentences.zh: 员工们上班打开电脑，却无法访问电子邮件或其他关键业务，而是看到了一条勒索通知。

sentences.en: And the note basically said, we've held your data and your systems hostage until you pay us millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 通知基本上说，我们已经扣押了你们的数据和系统，除非你们支付数百万美元。

sentences.en: The company notified authorities and hired an outside firm to investigate all of it.
sentences.zh: 该公司通知了当局，并聘请了一家外部公司调查此事。

sentences.en: You can imagine this may have an impact on already rising gas prices.
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，这可能会对本已上涨的汽油价格产生影响。

sentences.en: So at Colonial, the company just shut down the pipeline because with its billing systems frozen, it had no way to charge customers.
sentences.zh: 在科洛尼尔公司，由于计费系统瘫痪，无法向客户收费，公司直接关闭了管道。

sentences.en: And as a result...
sentences.zh: 结果就是……

sentences.en: This gas station behind me is out of regular gas.
sentences.zh: 我身后的这个加油站没有普通汽油了。

sentences.en: And there are thousands of gas stations just like this one up and down the east coaSt.
sentences.zh: 东海岸沿线有成千上万个像这样的加油站。

sentences.en: You saw panic buying at the pump.
sentences.zh: 你看到了加油站出现的恐慌性购买。

sentences.en: You saw nonstop flights have to ground themselves to pick up fuel en route to their destinations.
sentences.zh: 你看到不停飞的航班不得不停飞，以便在前往目的地的途中加油。

sentences.en: This had a really big visceral effect.
sentences.zh: 这产生了非常巨大的直接影响。

sentences.en: The FBI is investigating another major cyber attack affecting a key part of our economy.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局正在调查另一起影响我国经济关键部分的重大网络攻击。

sentences.en: Now it's the meat industry.
sentences.zh: 这次是肉类行业。

sentences.en: And then the second big attack was on JBS, which is one of the world's biggest beef suppliers.
sentences.zh: 第二次重大攻击针对的是全球最大的牛肉供应商之一——JBS公司。

sentences.en: JBS was forced to bring all of its U.S.
sentences.zh: 在这次破坏性的网络攻击之后，JBS被迫停止了其在美国的所有工厂运营。

sentences.en: plants to a halt after this crippling cyber attack.
sentences.zh: 在这次破坏性的网络攻击之后，JBS被迫停止了其在美国的所有工厂运营。

sentences.en: And there, ransomware criminals hit the company in the middle of a beef shortage.
sentences.zh: 在那里，勒索软件犯罪分子在牛肉短缺期间袭击了该公司。

sentences.en: The attack hitting as summer celebrations ramp up, with Father's Day and July 4th just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 这次攻击正值夏季庆祝活动增加之际，父亲节和7月4日独立日即将来临。

sentences.en: And so with that attack, you just started seeing the price of beef go up on menus.
sentences.zh: 随着那次攻击，你开始看到菜单上的牛肉价格上涨。

sentences.en: And you start seeing a lot of panic buying around beef supplies.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到围绕牛肉供应的恐慌性购买。

sentences.en: Okay, so in both of these cases, we're seeing these ransomware attacks, which look like attacks just on individual companies,
sentences.zh: 好的，在这两个案例中，我们看到的这些勒索软件攻击，看起来只是针对个别公司的攻击，

sentences.en: actually have an effect on the entire infrastructure of the American economy.
sentences.zh: 实际上却对整个美国经济的基础设施产生了影响。

sentences.en: So as a cybersecurity reporter, what did you think when you saw the news of these recent attacks?
sentences.zh: 作为一名网络安全记者，当你看到这些近期攻击的新闻时，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Well, for one, I wasn't surprised.
sentences.zh: 首先，我并不感到惊讶。

sentences.en: You know, we have been seeing ransomware attacks on all kinds of industries.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们一直在目睹针对各种行业的勒索软件攻击。

sentences.en: Just in the last couple of months, we've seen ransomware attacks on American mainstays, not just gas and meat, but television networks, police departments, NBA basketball teams,
sentences.zh: 就在过去几个月里，我们看到了针对美国支柱产业的勒索软件攻击，不仅仅是天然气和肉类，还有电视网络、警察局、NBA篮球队、

sentences.en: minor league baseball, ferries to Martha's Vineyard, hospitals.
sentences.zh: 小联盟棒球队、前往玛莎葡萄园岛的渡轮，以及医院。

sentences.en: And what's happening in the background is that these ransomware groups have been coming for our businesses and municipalities and cities and towns for a long time.
sentences.zh: 背景情况是，这些勒索软件组织长期以来一直针对我们的企业、市政机构、城市和城镇进行攻击。

sentences.en: But all of a sudden, they're hitting these industries that Americans are feeling for the first time.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，他们开始攻击那些让美国人首次感受到切肤之痛的行业。

sentences.en: We have this very potent, powerful image of gas running out and people not being able to get meat ahead of their 4th of July vacations.
sentences.zh: 我们有非常生动、强烈的画面，显示汽油耗尽，人们在7月4日假期前买不到肉。

sentences.en: And so suddenly, you know, you're seeing this big freak out among government agencies who have worried about ransomware for a long time.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，你会看到政府机构中出现了巨大的恐慌，他们长期以来一直担心勒索软件。

sentences.en: But suddenly, the problem is really catching up to them.
sentences.zh: 但现在，这个问题真的追上他们了。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: We've got some breaking news.
sentences.zh: 我们有一些突发新闻。

sentences.en: The Justice Department is elevating ransomware attacks to a similar priority level as terrorism following last month's Colonial Pipeline attack.
sentences.zh: 继上个月科洛尼尔管道运输公司遭袭后，司法部已将勒索软件攻击的优先级提升至与恐怖主义相当的水平。

sentences.en: You had FBI Director Christopher Wray last week who said dealing with ransomware is like dealing with the challenge of global terrorism after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局局长克里斯托弗·雷上周表示，应对勒索软件就像应对9·11事件后的全球恐怖主义挑战一样。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I want to update everyone on the ransomware cyber attack that impacted on the Colonial Pipeline.
sentences.zh: 我想向大家通报一下影响科洛尼尔管道运输公司的勒索软件网络攻击的最新情况。

sentences.en: You saw Biden get up to the podium and for the first time, an American president was speaking to the threat of ransomware.
sentences.zh: 你看到拜登走上讲台，这是美国总统首次就勒索软件威胁发表讲话。

sentences.en: And our Justice Department has launched a new task force dedicated to prosecuting ransomware hackers to the full extent of the law.
sentences.zh: 我们的司法部成立了一个新的特别工作组，专门致力于在法律允许的最大范围内起诉勒索软件黑客。

sentences.en: So suddenly, you see this scramble to deal with something that's been a pretty constant problem for the last couple years.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，你看到大家都在忙于应对一个过去几年里一直是个相当棘手的问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so what you've been describing is a billion-dollar industry that most of us didn't even realize exists.
sentences.zh: 好的，你所描述的是一个我们大多数人甚至没有意识到其存在的数十亿美元产业。

sentences.en: How did we get to this point?
sentences.zh: 我们是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: So ransomware has been going on for a long time.
sentences.zh: 勒索软件已经存在很长时间了。

sentences.en: But when I first started covering this about 10 years ago, it looked very different.
sentences.zh: 但我大约10年前刚开始报道这个领域时，情况看起来非常不同。

sentences.en: This was something that was hitting people's individual computers in Europe.
sentences.zh: 那时它攻击的是欧洲个人的电脑。

sentences.en: People would log on to their computer and they would see a ransomware note, only it purported to come from Interpol or the FBI.
sentences.zh: 人们登录电脑时会看到一条勒索通知，只是它声称来自国际刑警组织或联邦调查局。

sentences.en: And it said, hey, we've locked up your computer.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，嘿，我们锁定了你的电脑。

sentences.en: We know you've been looking at some illegal sites.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你一直在浏览一些非法网站。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's pornography.
sentences.zh: 有时是色情网站。

sentences.en: And we need you to pay this fine.
sentences.zh: 我们需要你支付这笔罚款。

sentences.en: And the fines were something like 100 to 200 euros in those days.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，罚款大约是100到200欧元。

sentences.en: And at the time, cybersecurity experts warned me that eventually this would come for the United States.
sentences.zh: 当时，网络安全专家警告我，这种情况最终会蔓延到美国。

sentences.en: And when it did, it didn't look that different.
sentences.zh: 当它真的发生时，看起来并没有什么不同。

sentences.en: It was ransomware groups holding up individual PC users and demanding $100 to $200 in fines.
sentences.zh: 那是勒索软件组织扣押个人电脑用户，并要求支付100到200美元的罚款。

sentences.en: But then something happened in 2017 that really brought ransomware to the next level.
sentences.zh: 但2017年发生了一件事，真正将勒索软件提升到了一个新的水平。

sentences.en: And that was the year we started seeing nation states use ransomware to bring entire companies and industries to their knees.
sentences.zh: 那一年，我们开始看到民族国家利用勒索软件使整个公司和行业陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: So just to back up, that year, we had seen this group come out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 回溯一下，那一年，我们看到这个组织突然冒了出来。

sentences.en: We still don't know who they are, but someone started showing up on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然不知道他们是谁，但有人开始在推特上出现。

sentences.en: They called themselves the Shadow Brokers.
sentences.zh: 他们自称为“影子经纪人”。

sentences.en: This week, a group called Shadow Brokers released what purports to be top secret computer code that the NSA has reportedly used to break into foreign government systeMs.
sentences.zh: 本周，一个名为“影子经纪人”的组织发布了据称是国家安全局（NSA）据报道用于入侵外国政府系统的绝密计算机代码。

sentences.en: And they claim to have hacked the NSA.
sentences.zh: 他们声称黑进了国家安全局。

sentences.en: And over a period of several months between 2016 and 2017, they started dribbling out some of the NSA's best kept hacking tools.
sentences.zh: 在2016年到2017年之间的几个月里，他们开始零星泄露国家安全局一些最严密保护的黑客工具。

sentences.en: These are tools that you use to break into an entire firewall for an entire computer network.
sentences.zh: 这些工具可以用来入侵整个计算机网络的防火墙。

sentences.en: This allows you to bypass all the defenses to simply walk in and be able to get into that network, more importantly, undetected.
sentences.zh: 这使你可以绕过所有防御，直接进入该网络，更重要的是，不被察觉。

sentences.en: And in 2017, we actually saw North Korea pick up one of the NSA's own tools and use it in a global ransomware attack that the industry called WannaCry.
sentences.zh: 2017年，我们确实看到朝鲜拿走了国家安全局自己的一个工具，并将其用于一场全球性的勒索软件攻击，业界称之为“想哭”（WannaCry）。

sentences.en: Cybersecurity experts are scrambling to recover from a massive cyber attack that hit nearly every corner of the world.
sentences.zh: 网络安全专家正忙于从一场袭击了全球几乎每个角落的大规模网络攻击中恢复过来。

sentences.en: WannaCry has paralyzed computers and banks and government agencies and factories in 150 countries since it was unleashed.
sentences.zh: 自“想哭”病毒爆发以来，它已经瘫痪了150个国家的电脑、银行、政府机构和工厂。

sentences.en: And really, the lasting legacy of WannaCry was that it didn't just come for individual PC users.
sentences.zh: 事实上，“想哭”留下的持久遗产是，它不仅仅针对个人电脑用户。

sentences.en: It hit entire businesses and hospitals.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了整个企业和医院。

sentences.en: So I was all ready to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经准备好了一切。

sentences.en: And then at Harpest One, the surgeon turned up and said, unfortunately, we've been hacked and there's nothing we can do.
sentences.zh: 然后在哈佩斯特一号医院，外科医生出现并说，不幸的是，我们被黑了，我们无能为力。

sentences.en: We can't operate on you today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天无法为您进行手术。

sentences.en: It actually hit the British health system.
sentences.zh: 它实际上袭击了英国的医疗系统。

sentences.en: Our focus at the moment is making sure that we end the disruption being caused by this particular attack.
sentences.zh: 我们目前的工作重点是确保结束这次特定攻击所造成的混乱。

sentences.en: And so we had these very powerful images of ambulances that were getting turned away from hospitals in the UK that had been held up with this North Korean ransomware.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到了非常震撼的画面，英国的救护车被医院拒之门外，因为医院被这种朝鲜的勒索软件劫持了。

sentences.en: And it was the first time that you could see that ransomware wasn't just something that would hold up an individual's computer.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次让你看到，勒索软件不仅仅是会扣押个人电脑的东西。

sentences.en: It was something that could cripple an entire hospital or entire industries.
sentences.zh: 它是一种可以瘫痪整个医院或整个行业的东西。

sentences.en: And it actually got worse.
sentences.zh: 而且情况实际上变得更糟了。

sentences.en: So one month after the North Korean attack, we saw Russia pick up the same NSA tools and use them in their own attack, this time just at Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 在朝鲜那次攻击一个月后，我们看到俄罗斯拿走了同样的国家安全局工具，并将其用于他们自己的攻击，这次仅仅针对乌克兰。

sentences.en: It hit every major Ukrainian government agency.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了乌克兰的每一个主要政府机构。

sentences.en: It hit their railways.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了他们的铁路。

sentences.en: It hit their post offices.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了他们的邮局。

sentences.en: It hit ATMs.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了自动取款机。

sentences.en: People couldn't get money out of ATMs.
sentences.zh: 人们无法从自动取款机里取钱。

sentences.en: And not only that, it actually ended up hitting any business that had any operation in Ukraine, even a single employee working from Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，它实际上最终袭击了任何在乌克兰有业务的公司，即使只有一个员工在乌克兰工作。

sentences.en: So it actually hit FedEx.
sentences.zh: 所以它实际上袭击了联邦快递。

sentences.en: FedEx suffered something like $400 million in damages.
sentences.zh: 联邦快递遭受了约4亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: It hit Merck.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了默克制药。

sentences.en: Merck actually had to tap into the CDC's emergency supplies of the Gardasil vaccine that year.
sentences.zh: 那一年，默克公司甚至不得不动用美国疾控中心（CDC）的加德西疫苗紧急储备。

sentences.en: It hit Cadbury egg factories in Tasmania.
sentences.zh: 它袭击了塔斯马尼亚的吉百利巧克力工厂。

sentences.en: All told, it actually cost $10 billion in damages.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，它实际上造成了100亿美元的损失。

sentences.en: It was, to this day, the most destructive cyber attack that we've seen.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，它仍然是我们所见过的最具破坏性的网络攻击。

sentences.en: But the legacy from that attack is that it really opened up cyber criminals' eyes to just how vulnerable these American businesses, some of our most critical businesses,
sentences.zh: 但那次攻击留下的遗产是，它真正让网络犯罪分子看到了这些美国企业，我们一些最关键的企业，是多么容易受到勒索软件的攻击，

sentences.en: were to ransomware.
sentences.zh: 是多么容易受到勒索软件的攻击，

sentences.en: And that these were really ripe targets.
sentences.zh: 而且这些确实是成熟的目标。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《纽约时报》一个月呢？

sentences.en: For free, without putting in a credit card.
sentences.zh: 免费，无需输入信用卡信息。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当您首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，您在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《纽约时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Nicole, what is it about American companies in particular that made them so vulnerable to these ransomware attacks?
sentences.zh: 妮可，美国公司有什么特别之处，使它们如此容易受到这些勒索软件攻击？

sentences.en: Well, it's a host of things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是多种因素造成的。

sentences.en: But I think it really just comes down to incentive models for businesses.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这真的归结为企业的激励模式。

sentences.en: You know, I'm based in Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我常驻硅谷。

sentences.en: And the operating MO here among big tech companies and startups is still very much Mark Zuckerberg's move fast and break things.
sentences.zh: 这里大型科技公司和初创企业的运营模式仍然很大程度上是马克·扎克伯格的“快速行动，打破常规”。

sentences.en: Get your software to market before the competition and you will win.
sentences.zh: 在竞争对手之前将软件推向市场，你就会赢。

sentences.en: And you can fix the bugs in your software and security glitches later.
sentences.zh: 至于软件中的漏洞和安全缺陷，以后再修复就行了。

sentences.en: And at the same time, we've all bought into the Silicon Valley promise of a frictionless society.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们都接受了硅谷关于无摩擦社会的承诺。

sentences.en: We have just been baking this buggy software into so many of our core industries like gas, like meat, like our factory production, like hospitals.
sentences.zh: 我们只是把这种有漏洞的软件植入到了我们太多的核心行业中，比如天然气、肉类、工厂生产、医院。

sentences.en: And we never stopped to think that maybe we were creating the world's ripest attack surface.
sentences.zh: 我们从未停下来思考，也许我们正在创造世界上最成熟的攻击面。

sentences.en: And so these ransomware groups realized that they could hold up entire businesses hostage and not just charge them $100 or $200, but millions of dollars to get their data back.
sentences.zh: 所以这些勒索软件组织意识到，他们可以扣押整个企业，不仅仅是索要100或200美元，而是数百万美元来换回数据。

sentences.en: And you start seeing businesses, even police departments, be willing to pay these fines just to get their data back.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到企业，甚至是警察局，为了拿回数据，愿意支付这些罚款。

sentences.en: We are learning that Colonial Pipeline did pay a ransom and the hackers had demanded about $5 million in cryptocurrency from the company.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到科洛尼尔管道运输公司确实支付了赎金，黑客曾向该公司索要约500万美元的加密货币。

sentences.en: Well, just in the past hour, NBC News has confirmed reports that Colonial Pipeline did pay nearly $5 million in ransom to those hackers.
sentences.zh: 就在过去一小时内，美国全国广播公司新闻频道（NBC News）证实了报道，称科洛尼尔管道运输公司确实向那些黑客支付了近500万美元的赎金。

sentences.en: Were you briefed on the fact that the company did pay the ransom?
sentences.zh: 你是否收到过关于公司确实支付了赎金这一事实的简报？

sentences.en: I have no comment on that.
sentences.zh: 对此我不予置评。

sentences.en: Is it legal to pay these groups?
sentences.zh: 向这些组织支付赎金合法吗？

sentences.en: I mean, isn't paying them essentially making the problem worse?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，支付赎金难道不是从根本上加剧了问题吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so it's not illegal.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这并不违法。

sentences.en: The FBI has come out and said, we really advise you not to pay these ransoMs.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局已经公开表示，我们强烈建议不要支付这些赎金。

sentences.en: But the reality on the ground is that when a company gets held hostage with this ransomware,
sentences.zh: 但现实情况是，当一家公司被这种勒索软件劫持时，

sentences.en: oftentimes the cost of the ransom is still cheaper than the cost of rebuilding their systems and data from scratch.
sentences.zh: 支付赎金的成本往往仍然低于从零开始重建系统和数据的成本。

sentences.en: So there was actually a ransomware attack in Baltimore that was pretty bad a couple years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前巴尔的摩确实发生过一次相当严重的勒索软件攻击。

sentences.en: And the hackers were demanding something like $75,000 in Bitcoin to hand them their data back.
sentences.zh: 黑客要求支付大约75000美元的比特币来交还他们的数据。

sentences.en: Baltimore refused to pay.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的摩拒绝支付。

sentences.en: And ultimately, the cost to rebuild all of those services that had been destroyed and held hostage in the ransomware attack was $18 million.
sentences.zh: 最终，重建所有在勒索软件攻击中被破坏和劫持的服务，花费了1800万美元。

sentences.en: And so over and over again,
sentences.zh: 所以一次又一次地，

sentences.en: you see businesses and their insurers really calculate that they should just go ahead and pay the ransom because the ransom demand is still so much cheaper than the cost to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 你会看到企业及其保险公司经过计算，认为他们应该直接支付赎金，因为赎金需求远低于重建成本。

sentences.en: Wow, that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 哇，这太惊人了。

sentences.en: $18 million versus $75,000.
sentences.zh: 1800万美元对比75000美元。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a lesson I would take from that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会从中吸取教训。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And who's getting all of this money?
sentences.zh: 那么是谁在拿这些钱呢？

sentences.en: Who are carrying out these attacks, like the one against Baltimore and the one against the oil pipeline?
sentences.zh: 是谁在实施这些攻击，比如针对巴尔的摩和输油管道的那两次？

sentences.en: So these are just people looking to make money.
sentences.zh: 这些人只是想赚钱。

sentences.en: You know, usually these are people who were working out of offices, almost like startups, and they're holding these businesses hostage for ransom.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们通常是在办公室里工作，几乎就像初创公司一样，他们以勒索赎金为目的劫持这些企业。

sentences.en: But the more companies and victims that were willing to pay their ransoms, the more money they were getting.
sentences.zh: 但愿意支付赎金的公司和受害者越多，他们得到的钱就越多。

sentences.en: And these became pretty sophisticated enterprises.
sentences.zh: 这些已经变成了相当复杂的企业。

sentences.en: Some of them are making hundreds of millions of dollars just over the past year.
sentences.zh: 其中一些在过去一年里就赚了数亿美元。

sentences.en: Right now, the FBI says it's tracking about 100 different ransomware groups.
sentences.zh: 目前，联邦调查局表示正在追踪大约100个不同的勒索软件组织。

sentences.en: Some of those are based in North Korea and Iran.
sentences.zh: 其中一些位于朝鲜和伊朗。

sentences.en: They popped up in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 它们在土耳其也出现过。

sentences.en: But the vast majority of them are in Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数位于东欧。

sentences.en: And we think most of them are actually based in Russia.
sentences.zh: 我们认为它们大多数实际上位于俄罗斯。

sentences.en: And why Russia?
sentences.zh: 为什么是俄罗斯？

sentences.en: Well, Putin has actually given Russia's cyber criminals safe harbor.
sentences.zh: 嗯，普京实际上为俄罗斯的网络罪犯提供了避风港。

sentences.en: He won't arrest them and he won't extradite them when we indict them here.
sentences.zh: 当我们在这里起诉他们时，他不会逮捕他们，也不会引渡他们。

sentences.en: And really, we think Putin has only two rules for Russia's cyber criminals.
sentences.zh: 我们确实认为普京对俄罗斯的网络罪犯只有两条规则。

sentences.en: The first is don't hack targets inside the motherland.
sentences.zh: 第一条是不要攻击祖国内部的目标。

sentences.en: And we actually see that in the code.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上在代码中看到了这一点。

sentences.en: In a lot of these ransomware attacks, the groups will go out of their way to search your computer for its default language setting.
sentences.zh: 在许多此类勒索软件攻击中，这些组织会特意搜索你电脑的默认语言设置。

sentences.en: And if you are a Russian language speaker, it won't infect you.
sentences.zh: 如果你是俄语使用者，它就不会感染你。

sentences.en: It'll move right along.
sentences.zh: 它会直接跳过。

sentences.en: The second rule we think Putin has is when we ask you to do a favor, you do whatever we ask.
sentences.zh: 我们认为普京的第二条规则是，当我们要求你帮个忙时，你必须照做。

sentences.en: And that allows Russia to basically tap into these cyber criminals for some of its more sensitive operations.
sentences.zh: 这使得俄罗斯基本上可以利用这些网络罪犯进行一些更敏感的行动。

sentences.en: So that should they get caught, the government can always say, we had nothing to do with this.
sentences.zh: 这样一旦他们被抓，政府总是可以说，我们与此无关。

sentences.en: We had no idea.
sentences.zh: 我们一无所知。

sentences.en: These are cyber criminals.
sentences.zh: 这些人是网络罪犯。

sentences.en: They operate on their own.
sentences.zh: 他们独立行动。

sentences.en: And we've actually seen Putin come out and say something to this effect.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上已经看到普京出来说过类似的话。

sentences.en: A few years ago, he said, listen, hackers are like artists.
sentences.zh: 几年前，他说，听着，黑客就像艺术家。

sentences.en: They just get up in the morning and start painting.
sentences.zh: 他们早上起床就开始作画。

sentences.en: We have no say over what they do or don't do.
sentences.zh: 我们无法左右他们的所作所为。

sentences.en: And that gives the government cover should it need to use these cyber criminals for some of these more sensitive operations.
sentences.zh: 这为政府在需要利用这些网络罪犯进行某些更敏感行动时提供了掩护。

sentences.en: So from the perspective of the United States, this seems like it creates a real national security threat.
sentences.zh: 所以从美国的角度来看，这似乎构成了真正的国家安全威胁。

sentences.en: You have ransomware attacks coming for the bedrock of our economy.
sentences.zh: 勒索软件攻击正威胁着我们经济的基石。

sentences.en: And they could be coming from the Russian state or from these groups of cyber criminals.
sentences.zh: 它们可能来自俄罗斯政府，也可能来自这些网络犯罪组织。

sentences.en: What can we do about this?
sentences.zh: 我们能做些什么呢？

sentences.en: It's not an easy ask, and it's pretty complicated.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个简单的要求，而且相当复杂。

sentences.en: But at the international level, it really starts with Biden getting up on that podium and speaking to the threat of ransomware for the first time as an American president.
sentences.zh: 但在国际层面上，这确实始于拜登首次以美国总统身份站在讲台上谈论勒索软件的威胁。

sentences.en: It's working with other allies to come up with cohesive policy around our response to ransomware attacks.
sentences.zh: 这是与盟友合作，就我们对勒索软件攻击的反应制定统一的政策。

sentences.en: And then domestically, it's things like, should Treasury have a rule that makes it illegal for victims of ransomware attacks to pay these ransoms?
sentences.zh: 而在国内，比如财政部是否应该出台规定，禁止勒索软件攻击的受害者支付赎金？

sentences.en: But the hardest thing we need to do is cyber hygiene.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要做的最困难的事情是网络卫生。

sentences.en: It's making ourselves less vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 即降低我们自身的脆弱性。

sentences.en: It's all the things that we've been told we needed to do for a very long time, creating different passwords for different websites, turning on two-factor authentication,
sentences.zh: 这就是我们长期以来被告知需要做的所有事情：为不同的网站创建不同的密码，开启双重身份验证，

sentences.en: running your software updates and your security updates.
sentences.zh: 运行软件更新和安全更新。

sentences.en: And that's where the focus really needs to go.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正需要关注的地方。

sentences.en: So a lot of it is really just on us, the boring, quiet, slow work of turning on two-step authentication.
sentences.zh: 所以很大程度上确实取决于我们自己，即开启双重身份验证这种枯燥、安静、缓慢的工作。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, they have this saying that security is only as good as your weakest link, and individuals and employees continue to be the weakest links.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有句俗话说，安全性取决于最薄弱的环节，而个人和员工仍然是最薄弱的环节。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you think about the Colonial Pipeline attack, think of it as almost this massive attack on our country.
sentences.zh: 而且，当你想到殖民管道攻击时，可以把它看作是对我们国家的一次大规模攻击。

sentences.en: But what it came down to was an employee who had this old, inactive account whose password had been stolen, and they hadn't turned on two-factor authentication.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，是一名员工拥有一个旧的、未激活的账户，其密码被盗，而且他们没有开启双重身份验证。

sentences.en: So as long as we're making it that easy for these ransomware groups, these ransomware attacks will continue.
sentences.zh: 所以只要我们继续为这些勒索软件组织提供便利，这些攻击就会持续下去。

sentences.en: And it doesn't matter what we're doing at the international level.
sentences.zh: 无论我们在国际层面做什么都无济于事。

sentences.en: When it's so easy to just hack an American company using a stolen password, these attacks won't go away.
sentences.zh: 当使用被盗密码黑进一家美国公司如此容易时，这些攻击就不会消失。

sentences.en: Nicole, thank you.
sentences.zh: 妮可，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: The sophisticated use of technology to hold businesses and even whole cities hostage for profit is decidedly a 21st century challenge.
sentences.zh: 利用先进技术劫持企业甚至整个城市以牟利，这无疑是21世纪的挑战。

sentences.en: But the old adage, follow the money, still applies.
sentences.zh: 但那句老话“顺藤摸瓜”依然适用。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, the Department of Justice said that it had recovered much of the ransom paid by Colonial Pipeline to end the ransomware attack staged by Darkseid.
sentences.zh: 周一下午，司法部表示已追回殖民管道公司为结束Darkseid发起的勒索软件攻击而支付的大部分赎金。

sentences.en: During a news conference, federal officials said they had seized $2.3 million worth of Bitcoin held by Darkseid, a little more than half of the ransom paid by Colonial.
sentences.zh: 在新闻发布会上，联邦官员表示他们查获了Darkseid持有的价值230万美元的比特币，略多于殖民管道公司支付赎金的一半。

sentences.en: Today, we turned the tables on Darkseid.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们扭转了对Darkseid的局势。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to nerdy.
sentences.zh: 以下是你还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: During her first foreign trip as vice president, Kamala Harris traveled to Guatemala,
sentences.zh: 作为副总统的首次出访，卡玛拉·哈里斯前往危地马拉，

sentences.en: where she bluntly warned immigrants across Central America against illegally crossing into the United States.
sentences.zh: 她在那里直言不讳地警告中美洲的移民不要非法越境进入美国。

sentences.en: The United States will continue to enforce our laws and secure our border.
sentences.zh: 美国将继续执行我们的法律并确保我们的边境安全。

sentences.en: There are legal methods by which migration can and should occur.
sentences.zh: 移民可以通过合法途径进行，也应该通过合法途径进行。

sentences.en: The trip marks the beginning of a broader U.S.
sentences.zh: 这次访问标志着美国一项更广泛努力的开始，

sentences.en: effort led by Harris to break the cycle of poverty and migration in the region and ultimately to stop the flow of migrants to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 该努力由哈里斯领导，旨在打破该地区的贫困和移民循环，并最终阻止移民流向美国。

sentences.en: border.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Robert Jemison, Daniel Guimet, and Annie Brown.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗伯特·杰米森、丹尼尔·吉梅特和安妮·布朗制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by M.J.
sentences.zh: 由M.J.戴维斯·林恩编辑，克里斯·伍德负责工程，并包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: Davis Lynn, engineered by Chris Wood, and contains original music by Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的内容。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴罗。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
